plan.failureSummary: Cached page.ai instructions failed to find the 'Last Name' input field during deterministic replay because the survey form fields have changed.
observedIndicators: Failure occurred during deterministic replay inside the cache file (.cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js).
The cached script attempted to find '[data-testid=\"input-lastname\"]' / 'Last Name *', but the failure screenshot shows the live page has 'Your Name *' and 'Contact Email *' instead.
isRetryAttempt is false and usedDeterministicMode is true.
The page itself is rendering healthy and responsive with no browser or network errors.
Flow history demonstrates successful past autonomous / cache-refresh runs.

remediationSteps.summary: Clear Page.AI cache and retry test
remediationSteps.details: Clear the cached Page.AI file at .cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js and re-run the test to allow Page.AI to autonomously discover and fill out the new form fields.

remediationSteps.summary: Review survey prompt instructions if failure persists
remediationSteps.details: If the retry fails after cache regeneration, inspect whether the dynamic survey steps require additional prompt guidance or relaxed assertions.

additionalDataRequests.description: Inspect the live survey DOM structure to verify current form field labels and inputs.

plan.notes: The survey application presents dynamic form variations. The cached replay was generated for a form with 'Last Name' and 'Email Address', but the current page displays 'Your Name', 'Contact Email', and 'Occupation'. Because the overall objective is semantically flexible ('Fill out the all of the survey questions with fake data...'), clearing the cache and retrying autonomously will allow the AI agent to adapt to the current form layout.
